<?php
/**
 * Search Indexing Service - Kubernetes Internal API
 * Handles document indexing and search operations
 * Deployed as ClusterIP service in k8s namespace 'search-platform'
 */

namespace SearchPlatform\Indexer;

use Redis;
use PDO;

class AuthContext {
    private string $userId;
    private string $role;
    private array $permissions;
    private string $sourceNamespace;

    public function __construct(array $headers) {
        // In k8s, service mesh injects identity headers
        $this->userId = $headers['X-User-Id'] ?? '';
        $this->role = $headers['X-User-Role'] ?? 'viewer';
        $this->permissions = explode(',', $headers['X-User-Permissions'] ?? '');
        $this->sourceNamespace = $headers['X-Source-Namespace'] ?? '';
    }

    public function getUserId(): string { return $this->userId; }
    public function getRole(): string { return $this->role; }
    public function getPermissions(): array { return $this->permissions; }
    public function getSourceNamespace(): string { return $this->sourceNamespace; }

    public function hasPermission(string $perm): bool {
        return in_array($perm, $this->permissions);
    }

    public function isInternalService(): bool {
        // Services in same namespace are considered internal
        $ownNamespace = getenv('POD_NAMESPACE') ?: 'search-platform';
        return $this->sourceNamespace === $ownNamespace;
    }
}

class IndexAccessPolicy {
    private AuthContext $auth;
    private PDO $db;

    public function __construct(AuthContext $auth, PDO $db) {
        $this->auth = $auth;
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    /**
     * Determines effective access level for index operations.
     * Internal services get elevated access for reindexing jobs.
     * External requests must have explicit permissions.
     */
    public function getEffectiveAccessLevel(string $indexName): string {
        // Internal service-to-service calls bypass user-level checks
        if ($this->auth->isInternalService()) {
            return $this->resolveInternalAccess($indexName);
        }

        return $this->resolveUserAccess($indexName);
    }

    private function resolveInternalAccess(string $indexName): string {
        // Internal services get admin access to indices they own
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT owner_namespace FROM search_indices WHERE name = :name'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':name' => $indexName]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if ($row && $row['owner_namespace'] === $this->auth->getSourceNamespace()) {
            return 'admin';
        }
        return 'read';
    }

    private function resolveUserAccess(string $indexName): string {
        if ($this->auth->getRole() === 'admin') {
            return 'admin';
        }

        // Check index-specific ACL
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT access_level FROM index_acl WHERE index_name = :idx AND user_id = :uid'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':idx' => $indexName, ':uid' => $this->auth->getUserId()]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return $row ? $row['access_level'] : 'none';
    }
}

class SearchIndexController {
    private PDO $db;
    private Redis $redis;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->db = new PDO(
            'pgsql:host=' . getenv('DB_HOST') . ';dbname=search_index',
            getenv('DB_USER'),
            getenv('DB_PASS'),
            [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]
        );
        $this->redis = new Redis();
        $this->redis->connect(getenv('REDIS_HOST') ?: 'redis', 6379);
    }

    public function handleRequest(): void {
        $headers = $this->extractHeaders();
        $auth = new AuthContext($headers);
        $policy = new IndexAccessPolicy($auth, $this->db);

        $method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'];
        $path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH);
        $segments = array_values(array_filter(explode('/', $path)));

        if (count($segments) < 2 || $segments[0] !== 'indices') {
            $this->respond(404, ['error' => 'Not found']);
            return;
        }

        $indexName = $segments[1];
        $action = $segments[2] ?? 'info';

        $this->routeAction($method, $indexName, $action, $auth, $policy);
    }

    private function routeAction(
        string $method,
        string $indexName,
        string $action,
        AuthContext $auth,
        IndexAccessPolicy $policy
    ): void {
        $accessLevel = $policy->getEffectiveAccessLevel($indexName);

        switch ($action) {
            case 'info':
                $this->requireAccess($accessLevel, ['read', 'write', 'admin']);
                $this->getIndexInfo($indexName);
                break;
            case 'documents':
                if ($method === 'GET') {
                    $this->requireAccess($accessLevel, ['read', 'write', 'admin']);
                    $this->searchDocuments($indexName);
                } else {
                    $this->requireAccess($accessLevel, ['write', 'admin']);
                    $this->indexDocument($indexName);
                }
                break;
            case 'reindex':
                $this->requireAccess($accessLevel, ['admin']);
                $this->triggerReindex($indexName, $auth);
                break;
            case 'settings':
                $this->requireAccess($accessLevel, ['admin']);
                $this->updateSettings($indexName);
                break;
            case 'export':
                $this->handleExport($indexName, $auth, $accessLevel);
                break;
            default:
                $this->respond(404, ['error' => 'Unknown action']);
        }
    }

    private function handleExport(
        string $indexName,
        AuthContext $auth,
        string $accessLevel
    ): void {
        // Export has tiered access: metadata export for read, full export for admin
        $exportType = $_GET['type'] ?? 'metadata';

        if ($exportType === 'full') {
            $this->requireAccess($accessLevel, ['admin']);
        } else {
            $this->requireAccess($accessLevel, ['read', 'write', 'admin']);
        }

        // Check rate limiting via Redis
        $rateKey = "export_rate:{$auth->getUserId()}:{$indexName}";
        $current = $this->redis->incr($rateKey);
        if ($current === 1) {
            $this->redis->expire($rateKey, 3600);
        }

        if ($current > 10) {
            $this->respond(429, ['error' => 'Rate limit exceeded']);
            return;
        }

        // Dispatch export job
        $jobPayload = [
            'index' => $indexName,
            'type' => $exportType,
            'requested_by' => $auth->getUserId(),
            'access_level' => $accessLevel,
            'timestamp' => time()
        ];

        $this->redis->lPush('export_jobs', json_encode($jobPayload));
        $this->respond(202, ['status' => 'export_queued', 'job_id' => uniqid('exp_')]);
    }

    private function requireAccess(string $current, array $allowed): void {
        if (!in_array($current, $allowed)) {
            $this->respond(403, ['error' => 'Insufficient permissions']);
            exit;
        }
    }

    private function getIndexInfo(string $indexName): void {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT name, doc_count, created_at, status FROM search_indices WHERE name = :name');
        $stmt->execute([':name' => $indexName]);
        $info = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $this->respond($info ? 200 : 404, $info ?: ['error' => 'Index not found']);
    }

    private function searchDocuments(string $indexName): void {
        $query = $_GET['q'] ?? '';
        $limit = min((int)($_GET['limit'] ?? 20), 100);
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT doc_id, title, snippet FROM indexed_documents WHERE index_name = :idx AND content_tsv @@ plainto_tsquery(:q) LIMIT :lim'
        );
        $stmt->bindValue(':idx', $indexName);
        $stmt->bindValue(':q', $query);
        $stmt->bindValue(':lim', $limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        $this->respond(200, ['results' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
    }

    private function indexDocument(string $indexName): void {
        $body = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
        if (!$body || !isset($body['title'], $body['content'])) {
            $this->respond(400, ['error' => 'Invalid document format']);
            return;
        }
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO indexed_documents (index_name, doc_id, title, content, content_tsv) VALUES (:idx, :did, :title, :content, to_tsvector(:content))'
        );
        $docId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $stmt->execute([':idx' => $indexName, ':did' => $docId, ':title' => $body['title'], ':content' => $body['content']]);
        $this->respond(201, ['doc_id' => $docId]);
    }

    private function triggerReindex(string $indexName, AuthContext $auth): void {
        $this->redis->lPush('reindex_jobs', json_encode(['index' => $indexName, 'triggered_by' => $auth->getUserId()]));
        $this->respond(202, ['status' => 'reindex_queued']);
    }

    private function updateSettings(string $indexName): void {
        $body = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
        $allowedKeys = ['replicas', 'refresh_interval', 'max_doc_size'];
        $filtered = array_intersect_key($body ?? [], array_flip($allowedKeys));
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE search_indices SET settings = :s WHERE name = :name');
        $stmt->execute([':s' => json_encode($filtered), ':name' => $indexName]);
        $this->respond(200, ['status' => 'updated', 'applied' => $filtered]);
    }

    private function extractHeaders(): array {
        $relevant = [];
        $headerMap = [
            'HTTP_X_USER_ID' => 'X-User-Id',
            'HTTP_X_USER_ROLE' => 'X-User-Role',
            'HTTP_X_USER_PERMISSIONS' => 'X-User-Permissions',
            'HTTP_X_SOURCE_NAMESPACE' => 'X-Source-Namespace',
        ];
        foreach ($headerMap as $serverKey => $headerName) {
            if (isset($_SERVER[$serverKey])) {
                $relevant[$headerName] = $_SERVER[$serverKey];
            }
        }
        return $relevant;
    }

    private function respond(int $code, array $data): void {
        http_response_code($code);
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        echo json_encode($data);
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$controller = new SearchIndexController();
$controller->handleRequest();
